note: Single source of truth for prompt wording. tools/imagegen.py assembles every prompt as: subject + style + blocks. Change wording here, never inline in batch files, so all assets stay consistent.

styles.storybook: Art style: premium 2D mobile game art, semi-flat storybook illustration. Clean, confident, simple shapes with minimal clutter; subtle paper-grain texture; thin dark-brown outlines of even weight; soft cel shading with at most two shade steps; gentle gradients only in skies and light glows.
styles.papercraft: Art style: premium 2D mobile game art that looks like a handcrafted layered papercraft diorama. Every shape is cut paper or thin card with crisp cut edges, visible paper-fibre texture and soft drop shadows between stacked layers; no outlines; simple flat colours per paper layer.
styles.silhouette: Art style: premium 2D mobile game art built from flat atmospheric silhouette layers. Distant layers are lighter and bluer, near layers darker; smooth gradient sky; minimal interior detail on shapes; crisp clean edges; warm light sources glow softly against the cold scene.
styles.anime_chibi: 画法：日系二次元动漫插画，线条干净，赛璐璐上色加柔和的光影过渡，不做成 3D。萌系、温馨治愈的手机游戏美术。Q 版小人：大头、两三头身，五官可爱，表情温柔开心。

blocks.palette: Colour palette: cold desaturated blues, slate greys and blue-white snow for the world and the metal (#1B2433, #3C4A5C, #7FA3B8, #E8EEF2); rust and old-wood browns (#7A4A32, #5C4636); warm amber and fire orange (#F2A65A, #E8692C, #FFD89A) used ONLY for lamps, lit windows, fire and other light sources.
blocks.mood: Mood: a bleak, freezing post-apocalyptic world, yet the train carries warmth, hope and human life.
blocks.side_view: Camera: strict orthographic side elevation, camera perpendicular to the train, no perspective, no vanishing points, level horizon.
blocks.cutaway: View: architectural cutaway cross-section of the carriage seen exactly from the side, like a dollhouse with the near wall removed; we look straight at the back wall; no perspective.
blocks.keyart: Composition: wide cinematic key art, readable at phone size, strong value contrast between the cold surroundings and the warm lights.
blocks.asset: Output: one single isolated game asset centred on a fully transparent background. No ground, no cast shadow on the ground, no scenery, nothing else in the image.
blocks.clean: No text, letters, numbers, logos, signatures, watermarks, UI or frames anywhere in the image.
blocks.template: The FIRST attached image is a strict layout template: keep the exact silhouette, proportions, size and position on the canvas, and keep every window, wheel and coupler exactly where it is. Only repaint it in the requested style and theme; do not add anything outside the silhouette.
blocks.template_character: The FIRST attached image is a strict pose template: keep the exact pose, body proportions (about 4 heads tall), limb positions, size and position on the canvas. Three-quarter view, facing right. Arms and legs must stay clearly separated from the body. Only dress and paint the figure.
blocks.style_ref: Match the art style, line weight, palette, texture and level of detail of the attached style reference image exactly.
blocks.spritesheet: This is a sprite sheet of EXACTLY the character in the FIRST attached image: identical face, hair, clothes, colours, proportions, outlines and art style in every frame. Layout: 8 frames in 4 columns x 2 rows of equal cells, read left to right, top to bottom. One full-body pose per cell, centred in its cell, the same size in every cell, feet on the same baseline height in every cell, side view facing right. Consecutive frames change smoothly and the last frame flows back into the first.
blocks.asset_sheet: Fully transparent background. No grid lines, cell borders, frame numbers, labels, text, ground or shadows.
blocks.pose_sheet: The FIRST attached image is a pose guide sheet: 8 frames in 4 columns x 2 rows of equal cells, read left to right, top to bottom. Each cell shows a simple mannequin in one pose of the animation. ORANGE limbs are the character's near (camera-side) arm and leg; BLUE limbs are the far arm and leg, behind the body; the gray shapes are the head and torso; the small dark wedge on the head shows the facing direction (right). Draw EXACTLY the character from the SECOND attached image in each of these 8 poses, in the same cell, at the same position and size, matching every limb angle, every joint bend and the head position of the mannequin. The mannequin is only a guide and must not be visible in the result. The character must look identical in every frame: same face, hair, clothes, colours, outlines and proportions.
blocks.style_ref_third: The THIRD attached image is the style reference: match its art style, line weight, palette, texture and level of detail.
blocks.warm_cold_cn: 颜色和光效：冷暖对比，和俯瞰图一致。车外是傍晚到入夜之间的蓝紫色天色和柔和的蓝白色雪光；车窗、灯、炉火、彩灯是暖橙色，灯光周围有柔和的光晕。整体温馨、治愈、可爱，带一点末日的冷清，但不阴暗、不恐怖。
blocks.clothing_cn: 衣着要合理：在车外冰天雪地里，人物穿全套防寒装——厚外套、加绒的长裤或雪裤、雪地靴、手套、帽子或围巾，不要短裙、短裤、丝袜、光腿、露肩露腰。在车厢里有暖气，可以穿毛衣、衬衫、围裙，但也不要暴露。衣服有生活感：耐磨布料、补丁、口袋、背带，干净可爱，不脏不破烂。
blocks.ending_cn: 不要文字，不要水印，不要标志。设计全部原创，不要模仿任何现有作品里的角色、火车或场景。
blocks.asset_cn: 游戏零件：只画这一个角色，居中，背景完全透明。不要地面、不要投影、不要场景、不要景深虚化。
blocks.pose_sheet_chibi: The FIRST attached image is a pose guide sheet: 8 frames in 4 columns x 2 rows of equal cells, read left to right, top to bottom. Each cell shows a simple big-headed chibi mannequin (about 2.5 heads tall) in one pose of the animation. ORANGE limbs are the character's near (camera-side) arm and leg; BLUE limbs are the far arm and leg, behind the body; the gray shapes are the head and torso; the small dark wedge on the head shows the facing direction (right). Draw EXACTLY the character from the SECOND attached image in each of these 8 poses, in the same cell, at the same position and size, matching every limb angle, every joint bend and the head position of the mannequin. The mannequin is only a guide and must not be visible in the result. The character must look identical in every frame: same face, hair, clothes, colours, outlines and proportions.
